instrument: ESO VLT FORS2, GRIS_300V, circular spectropolarimetry (PMOS)
reduction: ESO FORS pipeline 5.8.8 (fors_pmos_science); V/I by the difference method.
rotation_phase: bin 1 of 8, phase [0.125, 0.250) for P = 725.7 s and an arbitrary T0 = BJD_TDB 2460614.0 (no reliable absolute ephemeris); the bin of the cyclotron maximum.
resolution_fwhm_angstrom: about 23-26 (2.01 arcsec slit filled by ~3 arcsec seeing)
wavelength_frame: vacuum (from air with physical_air_to_vacuum), not barycentric-corrected
v_over_i_convention: optical (Landi Degl'Innocenti, Bagnulo & Fossati 2007), as exported by OpenWD and the ESO pipeline; IAU V/I = -v_over_i. Pass observed_convention='optical'.
v_over_i_level: v_over_i and sigma_v_over_i are divided by k = 1.654, which brings this reduction to the published 1990s V/I level of this star at the same phase; multiply both by 1.654 to recover the reduced level. About 8 % of the factor comes from the pipeline's local sky fit, which does not mask the star; the rest is unexplained. score_dah_circular_polarization reports such level differences as v_scale.
processing: Pixels with sigma >= 1 (masked by the reduction) dropped; no resampling.
acknowledgement: Based on observations collected at the European Organisation for Astronomical Research in the Southern Hemisphere under ESO programme 114.27BU.001.
